title: Fair and Kind to Everyone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Jehoshaphat, a good king, chose
Wise judges for the land,
To help decide what’s right and fair
With honest heart and hand.

[Chorus]
God wants me to be fair and kind
To everyone I see,
I’ll share, take turns, and leave none out,
The way He is with me.

[Verse 2]
He told them, “Careful now, be fair,
You judge for God above,
So do your work with happy hearts,
Be brave, and judge with love.”

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; tomorrow, share,
Take turns, and be a friend,
For God is fair and kind to you,
His love will never end.

[Chorus]
mood: Even music. A balanced, gently swinging pulse moves under the voice like a scale settling level, fair and unhurried, matching a king asking his judges to be honest and kind to everyone. The chorus keeps that even swing while it warms, like taking turns in a happy game. By the last verse the swing grows slower and lower, evening out into a soft, restful calm.
